policies.name: Data privacy
policies.rule_text: Never expose another customer's confidential information.
policies.parameter: referenced_customer_ids must contain only the recipient; draft must not contain another customer's name, company, email, or confidential field values

policies.name: Financial authority
policies.rule_text: Quotations above SGD 5,000 require owner approval.

policies.name: Evidence
policies.rule_text: Customer-facing technical claims need a supporting evidence record.
policies.parameter: every claim must match a verified evidence row
